description: Although Sheena had succeeded thanks to the advice of the Fighting Nun, things turned for the worse when the gang of bandits demanded she traded her relic gun for the life of a boy who had been taken hostage while attempting to protect his home—the sanctuary. Unexpectedly, however, the kidnapped boy caused a distraction that gave Sheena the upper hand once again, allowing the Sheriff, the Fighting Nun, and the hopeful locals to aid her in the fight against the bandits. After rising victorious against the villains, the leader of the gang of bandits challenged Sheena to one last duel. Once the two relic gun wielders faced each other off, only the righteous one would remain standing. Sheena began wielding both relic guns thereafter, leaving many to wonder exactly who she was.
summon:
As long as evil exists, my journey's not over.
I'll go wherever my help is needed, that's the path I've chosen.
fusion:
I understand now...
This relic gun wants to be used for good things, and I'm not about to let it down!
evolution:
I will follow my own sense of justice from now on.
What about you? What's justice in your eyes?
